welcome_message: Come together for a blessed day of worship, fellowship, learning, and spiritual growth.
church_introduction: CSI Wesley Church, Palliwada warmly welcomes all youth, students, and believers in the precious name of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. Under the Church of South India (CSI), Diocese of Karimnagar, Aler Group Church Council, and Mothkur Pastorate, our church stands in Palliwada village in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district of Telangana as a sanctuary of prayer, spiritual renewal, and active fellowship.
